scope: Exact original releases discovered through requested GamerHack review. Original-only Downloads and explicitly opted-in user-selected BIN loading. No public payload mirror.

actions.label: Orbis Toolbox · 5.05
actions.license: Original compiled pre-release by OSM-Made. No open-source or redistribution licence is asserted; Download uses the original release asset, and Load reads a user-selected exact file without persistence.
actions.imageDescription: Existing PS4 console artwork; not an Orbis Toolbox interface screenshot.
requirements: PS4 firmware 5.05 only. Download the matching Orbis Toolbox 1.0.1190 BIN; other firmware builds are separate files.
Start a compatible HEN before loading Orbis Toolbox. The original author reports Mira and GoldHEN support; use retail executables, not Hybrid Flasher or Updater POC.
Load requires an already running compatible GoldHEN HTTP BinLoader on port 9090 and the paired desktop sender. Select the exact original BIN downloaded above.
This is an alpha pre-release. The original GoldHEN release reports possible rest-mode problems with Orbis Toolbox.
A successful transfer does not prove Orbis Toolbox executed. Check the console before loading another payload.

loaderEvidence.source: Original release requires HEN then the exact firmware BIN; original README names Mira and GoldHEN. GoldHEN HTTP9090 is the existing reviewed flat-BIN transport after its readiness check.

actions.label: GoldHEN 2.4b18 · 9.00
actions.license: Official compiled GoldHEN release by SiSTRo. No open-source or redistribution licence is asserted; Download uses the pinned original publisher file, and Load reads a user-selected exact file without persistence.
requirements: This Load action is for PS4 firmware 9.00 only. Start the built-in PSFree / Lapse loader on the console and wait for its BIN listener on TCP 9020.
Connect the paired desktop sender, choose Load and select the exact original GoldHEN 2.4b18 goldhen.bin downloaded above. The sender verifies its size and SHA-256 before transfer.
The official 2.4b18 release supports previous WebKit entry points and PPPwn. PPPwn requires the release-specific custom stage2; this action uses the separate waiting PS4 9.00 BIN listener.
This is official 2.4b18, not a host-modified 2.4b18.12 build. No PS4 13.xx, 14.00 or PS5 support is established by this entry.
TCP delivery confirms a transfer only. Check the console for successful GoldHEN execution before sending another payload.

extraction.transformation: 7-Zip member decompression only; exact bytes also match the official commit-pinned raw BIN.

loaderEvidence.source: Official release lists9.00 and previous WebKit support; the existing pinned PSFree/Lapse runBinLoader receives raw flat BIN bytes on9020. The ready file has a flat x64 jump entry rather than an ELF header. Protocol integration is structurally reviewed and mock-tested, not physically executed.
